meta.intensity_reason: France PA mandate under 8 weeks away (1 Sept 2026) with PA registration ~50% - Cegid closes EUR 1.1bn Shine acquisition (1M+ SMBs, 15,000 accountants across 7 markets) - Pennylane now live in Germany and valued at USD 4.25bn - converging FR/ES/DE/PT compliance deadlines
meta.ifyrne: The German B2B e-invoicing mandate, with full implementation by January 2028, presents a significant opportunity for Sage to drive adoption of Sage Active, while Pennylane's aggressive expansion into Spain and Portugal, ahead of our planned Sage Active launch, poses a direct competitive threat. We must accelerate our Spanish market entry to counter Pennylane's encroachment and leverage Sage Active's French mandate compliance as a springboard for broader European success. Given Cegid's recent hiring of 100 new French sales representatives targeting German practices, we need to urgently address the unresolved GE-Active sync to ensure our German offering is competitive. The single most important action Sage must take this week is to finalize the GE-Active sync resolution plan.
meta.last_scan_summary: Automated evidence scan completed: 7 new signals passed source, date and quality checks.

summaries.FR: The French market shows high activity around the upcoming e-invoicing mandate, with Sage actively promoting its compliant solutions and competitors like Pennylane aggressively targeting the accounting professional channel.
summaries.ES: Market signals for Spain show confirmed Verifactu deadlines for 2027, competitive moves by Holded in Verifactu integration, and Sage's ongoing AI enhancements for Sage Active.
summaries.DE: Market signals in Germany show significant competitive and regulatory activity, with DATEV's cloud transition, Cegid's acquisition of sevdesk, and the upcoming B2B e-invoicing mandate creating a dynamic landscape.

signals.title: Germany's B2B E-invoicing Obligation Begins 2025, Transitioning Through 2028
signals.body: While XRechnung has been mandatory for B2G (business-to-government) invoicing since November 2020, Germany's B2B e-invoicing obligation is set to commence in 2025, with transitional periods extending through 2028. XRechnung is a machine-readable XML format based on EN 16931, designed for automated processing.
signals.implication: The impending B2B e-invoicing mandate in Germany presents a significant opportunity for Sage Active and AutoEntry+AKAO to capture market share by offering compliant solutions. Competitors like Cegid and Pennylane will also be targeting this transition.

signals.title: Cegid Accelerates DACH Expansion with Sevdesk Integration
signals.body: Cegid's acquisition of sevdesk, completed on February 24, 2025, is a key milestone for its international growth, particularly in German-speaking Europe. Sevdesk, with over 130,000 customers and processing over €85 billion in transactions, is preparing its clients for upcoming e-invoicing reforms starting from 2025. Cegid aims to leverage sevdesk's cloud-native solutions to support businesses in their digital transformation.
signals.implication: Cegid's strengthened presence in the DACH region through sevdesk poses a direct competitive threat, especially as they are preparing clients for e-invoicing reforms, an area where Sage WiSE has strategic interests.

signals.title: DATEV Mandates Cloud Transition by End of 2027, Increasing Cost Uncertainty
signals.body: DATEV is mandating a transition to its new user license model by the end of 2027, with a shift towards usage-dependent pricing instead of fixed monthly fees. This transition, coupled with the upcoming e-invoicing obligations starting in 2027/2028, creates significant pressure for tax firms and their clients to adapt. Alternatives like Lexware Neue Steuerkanzlei and Lexware Office are positioning themselves as solutions for this transition, offering integrated e-invoicing capabilities.
signals.implication: Sage needs to accelerate its cloud strategy in Germany and highlight the cost predictability and integration benefits of Sage for Accountants (SfA) and Sage Active in contrast to DATEV's shifting pricing models.

signals.title: Sage Active enhances AI features for Spanish businesses
signals.body: Sage Active has been updated with new AI-driven insights and automation capabilities, including instant balance sheet analysis, to help Spanish small businesses make better decisions and reduce administrative tasks. These enhancements are available to all users in Spain.
signals.implication: Sage is investing in AI for Sage Active in Spain, which could enhance its offering. However, the focus on AI needs to be balanced with ensuring core compliance features like Verifactu are robust and prioritized.

signals.title: Holded integrates Verifactu for invoice issuance and receipt validation
signals.body: Holded has integrated Verifactu capabilities, allowing users to issue compliant invoices with QR codes and chain hashes, and to validate incoming Verifactu invoices against the AEAT service. This integration supports both invoice issuance and the recipient's responsibility for validation and archiving.
signals.implication: Holded is actively preparing for Verifactu, posing a competitive threat in the Spanish market. Sage must accelerate its Verifactu compliance for Sage Active and SfA to remain competitive.

signals.title: Pennylane hosts 'Rendez-Vous' events for French accountants focusing on e-invoicing and AI.
signals.body: Pennylane is actively engaging with French accounting firms through its 'Rendez-Vous' events in cities like Toulouse (January 20, 2026), Metz (February 5, 2026), and Paris (February 10, 2026). These events focus on the future of the accounting profession, with key themes including e-invoicing as an opportunity, AI as a lever, and the recomposition of service offerings.
signals.implication: Pennylane is making a significant push to capture the French expert-comptable channel by directly addressing their concerns and opportunities related to the upcoming e-invoicing mandate and AI. This indicates a strong competitive strategy targeting this crucial segment, which Sage WiSE must counter.

signals.title: Sage Active FR emphasizes e-invoicing compliance and AI features.
signals.body: Sage Active in France is being promoted as a cloud-based, all-in-one solution for small businesses, emphasizing its compliance with e-invoicing regulations and its AI-powered features like 'Sage Copilot'. The product is highlighted as being compatible with the new electronic invoicing requirements, including connection to a Partner Platform (PA).
signals.implication: Sage is actively positioning Sage Active as a compliant solution for the French e-invoicing mandate. This suggests a strategic focus on this market and product, which needs to be monitored against competitors like Pennylane and Cegid who are also heavily marketing their compliance capabilities.

signals.title: Germany's B2B e-invoicing mandate to be fully mandatory by January 2028
signals.body: Germany's B2B e-invoicing mandate, part of the Wachstumschancengesetz, will become fully mandatory by January 2028 for all companies, with phased implementation starting in January 2027 for businesses with turnover over €800,000. All companies must be able to receive electronic invoices from January 2025.
signals.implication: The impending mandatory e-invoicing in Germany by 2028 creates a significant market opportunity for Sage's products, particularly those that can facilitate compliance with XRechnung and ZUGFeRD formats. Proactive positioning and feature development are crucial.

signals.title: France's e-invoicing mandate begins Sept 1, 2026, impacting all businesses.
signals.body: As of September 1, 2026, all businesses in France must be capable of receiving electronic invoices, with large and medium-sized enterprises also required to issue them. This reform, affecting over 10 million economic actors, necessitates the use of state-approved platforms for invoice transmission and data reporting. Smaller businesses will be required to issue e-invoices starting September 1, 2027.
signals.implication: Sage Active and Sage for Accountants must ensure full compliance and readiness for the French PA mandate, including integration with approved platforms, to avoid penalties and maintain market position.

signals.title: Sage Active FR compliant with 2026 e-invoicing mandate
signals.body: Sage Active is positioned as a cloud-based, AI-powered solution for small businesses, emphasizing its compliance with the upcoming French electronic invoicing mandate effective September 1, 2026. The product aims to automate financial, purchasing, and sales workflows, enabling real-time cash flow tracking.
signals.implication: Sage Active is addressing the French regulatory deadline, which is a positive signal for its market readiness. However, it's crucial to monitor how effectively it integrates with the mandated platforms and if competitors offer similar or superior compliance features.

signals.title: Holded promotes early Verifactu adaptation for businesses and freelancers
signals.body: Holded, a cloud ERP and invoicing platform, is actively encouraging businesses and freelancers to adapt to Verifactu ahead of the 2027 deadlines. They highlight that early adoption allows for testing, issue resolution, and user familiarization, preventing a rushed transition.
signals.implication: Holded's proactive stance on Verifactu compliance could give them a competitive edge in the Spanish market, especially among SMEs and freelancers who may delay their own adaptation.

signals.title: XRechnung 4.0 specification to be released in H2 2026, impacting B2B mandate
signals.body: Germany's XRechnung standard is evolving to version 4.0, based on EN 16931-1:2026. A preliminary version is expected in H2 2026, with the final specification to follow. This update introduces significant changes, including multi-order support, a revamped data model, and ViDA-ready fields, and will be crucial for the upcoming B2B e-invoicing mandate scheduled for January 2027 and January 2028.
signals.implication: Sage must monitor XRechnung 4.0 developments closely to ensure SfA Spain and future German offerings are compliant with the new standard, especially given the upcoming B2B mandate deadlines.

signals.title: Germany's B2B e-invoicing mandate phases in, with full implementation by Jan 2028.
signals.body: Germany's B2B e-invoicing mandate, driven by the Growth Opportunities Act, will be fully implemented by January 2028. All businesses must be able to receive structured e-invoices from January 2025. From January 2027, businesses with an annual turnover exceeding €800,000 must issue e-invoices for domestic B2B transactions. By January 2028, this requirement extends to all businesses. Accepted formats include XRechnung and ZUGFeRD 2.1+, compliant with EN 16931.
signals.implication: This regulatory deadline is a critical driver for accounting software adoption and upgrades in Germany. Sage must ensure its products are fully compliant and actively market this compliance to German businesses and accountants to capture market share before the 2028 deadline.

signals.title: Pennylane Officially Launches in Germany, Plans Expansion into Spain, Portugal, and Belgium
signals.body: Pennylane has officially launched in the German market with a new Munich office and plans to create over 100 new jobs there. The company also reportedly plans to establish a presence in Poland, Spain, and Belgium in the second half of 2026. This expansion is supported by its recent €175 million funding round.
signals.implication: Pennylane's aggressive expansion into Spain and Portugal, ahead of Sage Active's planned launch in Spain, presents a significant risk of market capture and competitive disadvantage for Sage WiSE.

signals.title: Pennylane Enhances ComptAssistant AI for Accountants with Expanded Capabilities
signals.body: Pennylane has updated its ComptAssistant AI, which acts as an AI assistant for accountants. It can now answer questions on taxation, regulation, client financial health, and portfolio segmentation, drawing from sources like the PCG, BOFiP, and accounting data. The AI's responses are contextualized to the client's file and data remains within the European Pennylane environment, adhering to ISO 27001 and SOC 2 standards.
signals.implication: Advancements in Pennylane's AI capabilities, particularly ComptAssistant, enhance its value proposition for accountants, potentially drawing them away from Sage's offerings by providing more sophisticated advisory and analytical tools.

signals.title: Cegid Primavera actively hiring across Portugal for ERP roles
signals.body: Cegid Primavera has posted numerous job openings on September 9, 2026, for various ERP-related positions, including consultants and sales engineers, across Lisbon and Porto. This indicates significant investment and expansion in the Portuguese market.
signals.implication: Cegid's aggressive hiring suggests a strong push to capture market share, potentially impacting Sage's position, especially in the accountant channel.

signals.title: Cegid Portugal Reports Strong Growth and AI Focus Post-PHC Acquisition
signals.body: Cegid Portugal, following the integration of PHC Business Software in 2025, reported a turnover of €85 million last year and aims for 10% growth in 2026. The company is prioritizing the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into daily business management, with AI adoption by its clients increasing by 128% in the last six months. Cegid Portugal leads operations in Portugal and Africa, employing 700 staff and working with over 500 partners.
signals.implication: Cegid's aggressive growth and focus on AI post-PHC acquisition in Portugal intensifies competition, particularly as they leverage integrated solutions and a strong partner network.

signals.title: Cegid Portugal Aims for 10% Growth in 2026, Focuses on AI Integration
signals.body: Cegid Portugal, now fully integrated with Primavera and PHC, reported €85 million in revenue for 2025 and aims for 10% growth in 2026. The company is prioritizing the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into daily business management, with a 128% increase in AI adoption among its clients in the last six months. Cegid leads its operations in Portugal and Africa with a team of 700 employees and a network of over 500 partners.
signals.implication: Cegid's aggressive growth strategy, coupled with a strong focus on AI and a consolidated partner network post-PHC acquisition, positions them as a significant threat in the Portuguese market. Sage WiSE needs to monitor Cegid's AI offerings and partner strategy closely.

signals.title: Cegid Portugal Focuses on AI Integration and Growth, Leveraging Primavera and PHC Acquisitions
signals.body: Cegid Portugal, formed from the integration of Primavera and PHC, reported €85 million in revenue last year and aims for 10% growth in 2026. The company is prioritizing the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into daily business management, with AI adoption among its clients increasing by 128% in the last six months. Cegid leads operations in Portugal and Africa with a team of 700 employees and over 500 partners in Portugal.
signals.implication: Cegid's aggressive growth strategy and focus on AI, powered by the combined strength of Primavera and PHC, represent a significant competitive threat in the Portuguese market, particularly for accounting practices.

signals.title: Portugal Postpones SAF-T Accounting and Qualified Electronic Signature Mandates to 2027
signals.body: Portugal's 2026 State Budget proposal has confirmed new transition periods, postponing the mandatory use of Qualified Electronic Signatures (QES) and SAF-T accounting obligations to 2027. PDF invoices will remain valid until December 31, 2026, with QES becoming mandatory from January 1, 2027. The first SAF-T accounting file submissions, originally due for fiscal year 2026, are now required from fiscal year 2027 onwards, with the first submission due in 2028.
signals.implication: This delay provides a slight buffer for Sage to ensure its solutions are fully compliant with the new SAF-T and QES requirements in Portugal, but the core regulatory deadlines are approaching.

signals.title: Cegid Portugal: "We have the mission to bring AI to the daily management of companies"
signals.body: Cegid Portugal registered a turnover of 85 million euros last year, with an objective to grow 10% in 2026, driven by the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI). The company aims to bring AI to the daily management of businesses, with AI adoption among Cegid's clients growing 128% in the last six months. Cegid Portugal leads operations in Portugal and Africa, with a team of 700 employees and a network of over 500 partners in Portugal.
signals.implication: Cegid's aggressive growth strategy and focus on AI in Portugal, post-PHC acquisition, presents a significant competitive threat, especially in targeting SMEs.

signals.title: Pennylane's ComptAssistant AI offers advanced accounting and tax assistance
signals.body: ComptAssistant, Pennylane's integrated AI assistant, provides real-time, contextualized answers to accounting, tax, and regulatory questions, drawing from reliable sources like the PCG and BOFiP. It functions as a co-pilot, understanding client dossiers and offering insights on financial health, portfolio segmentation, and platform usage.. Pennylane emphasizes data security, with ComptAssistant's reasoning remaining within Pennylane's environment and not used for external model training.
signals.implication: Pennylane's continuous investment in AI, exemplified by ComptAssistant, enhances its value proposition for accountants and SMEs. Sage needs to ensure its own AI capabilities are competitive and effectively integrated to avoid falling behind in providing intelligent automation and support.

signals.title: Portugal Extends B2G E-invoicing Mandate to SMEs from Jan 2027; PDF Invoice Validity Until Dec 2026
signals.body: Portugal's B2G e-invoicing mandate, requiring structured CIUS-PT format, now extends to medium, small, and micro-enterprises starting January 1, 2027. PDF invoices with QR codes issued by certified software remain valid until December 31, 2026. From January 1, 2027, structured CIUS-PT invoices or QES on PDFs will be required.
signals.implication: While the B2G mandate expansion to SMEs is in 2027, it highlights Portugal's ongoing digital transformation. Sage needs to ensure its solutions are fully compliant with these evolving e-invoicing requirements to maintain competitiveness.

signals.title: Cegid Portugal Reports €85M Revenue, Focuses on AI Integration Post-PHC Acquisition
signals.body: Cegid Portugal reported €85 million in revenue for 2025, the year it acquired PHC Software. The company aims for 10% growth in 2026, with a strong emphasis on integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) into its daily business management solutions. Cegid's AI adoption among clients has grown by 128% in the last six months.
signals.implication: Cegid's aggressive integration of PHC and focus on AI presents a significant competitive threat in Portugal. Sage WiSE needs to monitor Cegid's AI capabilities and market penetration closely, especially concerning its offerings for accountants.

signals.title: DATEV begins cloud migration of core modules in Autumn 2026
signals.body: DATEV is migrating its on-premises software to cloud-based delivery, starting with the Kanzleimanagement (practice management) module in Autumn 2026, followed by payroll, financial accounting, and tax modules. On-premises versions will be phased out over the coming years, impacting interfaces and workflows for practices and their Steuerberater.
signals.implication: DATEV's cloud migration could lead to a more modern and integrated offering, potentially increasing its competitive advantage and requiring Sage to adapt its own cloud strategy for the German market.

signals.title: Portugal: Qualified Electronic Signature mandatory for PDF invoices from Jan 1, 2027
signals.body: From January 1, 2027, PDF invoices in Portugal will require a Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) to be considered valid electronic documents. This change applies to all invoices not exchanged via Electronic Data Interchange (EDI). Simple PDF invoices will no longer be accepted without a QES after this date.
signals.implication: SfA and Sage Active will need to ensure their Portuguese offerings support QES for PDF invoices by the January 1, 2027 deadline to remain compliant.

signals.title: Sage Active France integrates PA Sage for 2026 electronic invoicing mandate
signals.body: Sage Active in France is now compliant with the upcoming electronic invoicing mandate effective September 1, 2026. The solution integrates 'PA Sage', a certified platform, ensuring businesses can send and receive electronic invoices without additional cost. This addresses the regulatory requirement for all VAT-subjected businesses in France.
signals.implication: Sage is proactively addressing the French PA mandate, positioning Sage Active as a compliant solution. This could be a competitive advantage if competitors are slower to integrate similar certified platforms.

signals.title: Holded emphasizes Verifactu compliance and deadlines
signals.body: Holded has published guidance explaining the differences between Verifactu and 'No Verifactu' modes, detailing deadlines up to 2027. They highlight that the Verifactu mode sends invoices to the tax agency in real-time, while 'No Verifactu' stores them for potential request. Holded also outlines the sanctions for non-compliance, which can reach up to €50,000 for users.
signals.implication: Holded is actively marketing its Verifactu readiness, which could sway accountants and businesses in Spain. Sage needs to clearly communicate its own Verifactu compliance and support for Spanish users.

signals.title: Verifactu deadlines confirmed for Jan 2027 (companies) and July 2027 (self-employed)
signals.body: The Verifactu system, Spain's new secure invoicing regulation, has confirmed its mandatory implementation dates. Companies subject to corporate tax must comply by January 1, 2027, while self-employed individuals (autónomos) have until July 1, 2027. Non-compliance can result in fines of up to €50,000 per year for users.
signals.implication: Sage Active must ensure full compliance and readiness for Verifactu by the specified deadlines to avoid penalties and maintain market competitiveness. Competitors like Holded are already highlighting their Verifactu compliance, putting pressure on Sage to do the same.

signals.title: AutoEntry Integration with Sage for Accountants in France
signals.body: Sage is actively promoting the integration of AutoEntry with its Sage for Accountants platform in France, highlighting its role in managing electronic invoices and preparing for the September 2026 mandate. The integration aims to automate data capture and streamline invoice processing between accountants and their clients.
signals.implication: While the AutoEntry integration is a positive step for document capture, ensuring its robust performance and ease of use for French accountants and their clients will be key to its success against competitors.

signals.title: Lexware (Haufe Group) continues to focus on cloud and AI for SMB accounting
signals.body: Lexware, part of the Haufe Group, continues to develop its cloud-based accounting software, lexoffice, which serves 250,000 small businesses and freelancers in Germany. Recent developments include enhanced AI features and a focus on simplifying accounting processes. Lexware has also recently become a main sponsor of SC Freiburg, increasing its brand visibility.
signals.implication: Lexoffice's ongoing investment in cloud and AI, coupled with increased brand visibility, presents a growing competitive threat in the German SMB market, potentially drawing customers seeking modern, integrated solutions.

signals.title: Pennylane launches in Spain with a PYMES-first strategy focused on Verifactu
signals.body: Pennylane has launched its operations in Spain with a PYMES-first strategy, specifically targeting the Verifactu regulatory window of 2027. The company aims to build a comprehensive accounting production platform and is hiring for its initial launch team in Spain, focusing on providing excellent customer experience for Spanish-speaking SMEs and advisors. Pennylane already serves over 1.3 million SMEs and 7,000 accounting firms in France.
signals.implication: Pennylane's strategic entry into Spain, leveraging the Verifactu regulation, poses a direct competitive threat to Sage Active's market position, especially given Pennylane's established success in France and its focus on the SME and accounting firm segments.

signals.title: Portugal's SAF-T Accounting Mandate Effective from Fiscal Year 2027
signals.body: The mandatory submission of the SAF-T Accounting file (Contabilidade) in Portugal is now set to apply from the fiscal year 2027, with the first submission due in 2028. This postponement provides businesses additional time to ensure their accounting systems are fully compliant with the comprehensive data requirements of this file type.
signals.implication: Sage needs to ensure its accounting solutions are fully compliant with the SAF-T Accounting requirements for the Portuguese market by the 2027 fiscal year deadline. This is a critical regulatory change impacting all businesses operating in Portugal.

signals.title: Germany clarifies e-invoicing mandate: universal sending by 2028, BMF updates FAQs.
signals.body: Germany's Federal Ministry of Finance (BMF) updated its e-invoicing FAQs on March 23, 2026, clarifying that universal mandatory structured invoicing will be in effect by January 1, 2028. The mandate requires businesses with an annual turnover exceeding €800,000 to issue structured e-invoices from January 2027. The BMF clarified format errors, business rule violations, and the mandatory use of validation tools.
signals.implication: The confirmed 2028 deadline for universal e-invoicing in Germany reinforces the urgency for businesses and their software providers to comply. Sage must ensure its solutions, particularly Sage for Accountants, are fully compliant and actively market this capability to German accounting firms.

signals.title: AutoEntry App Update Includes France Availability and Smarter Data Capture
signals.body: AutoEntry's mobile app has been updated to include availability in France, with enhanced features for automatic data capture from invoices and receipts. This update, released on August 12, 2026, aims to improve efficiency and accuracy for users in the French market, ahead of the September 1, 2026, e-invoicing mandate.
signals.implication: Sage needs to ensure its Sage Active and other relevant products are fully integrated and promoted with AutoEntry's enhanced French capabilities to compete effectively in the upcoming mandate.

signals.title: Portugal's B2G E-invoicing Mandate Expands to SMEs in 2026
signals.body: As of January 1, 2026, Portugal's mandatory e-invoicing for business-to-government (B2G) transactions now includes small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and micro-enterprises, in addition to large enterprises which have been in scope since 2021. While structured B2B e-invoicing is not yet mandatory, all invoices must use certified software and include a QR code and ATCUD.
signals.implication: The expansion of B2G e-invoicing to SMEs in Portugal presents an opportunity for Sage to offer compliant solutions. However, it also highlights the evolving regulatory landscape and the need to stay ahead of similar mandates in other markets.

signals.title: 166 Approved Platforms for French E-invoicing Mandate by Sept 2026
signals.body: As of July 24, 2026, 166 platforms have been approved by the DGFiP to handle electronic invoicing, with 9 offering free services and 24 providing trial periods. The mandate requires all VAT-registered businesses to be able to receive e-invoices by September 1, 2026, with penalties of €15 per non-compliant invoice.
signals.implication: Sage needs to ensure its solutions are integrated with or recognized by these approved platforms, or that Sage itself becomes an approved platform to avoid clients facing penalties and to maintain market share.

signals.title: OCC to host 8th Congress of Certified Accountants in September 2026
signals.body: The Ordem dos Contabilistas Certificados (OCC) will organize its 8th Congress of Certified Accountants from September 22-24, 2026, at the MEO Arena in Lisbon. Registration is now open.
signals.implication: The OCC Congress presents an opportunity for engagement with the Portuguese accounting channel, allowing for direct interaction and understanding of their needs and perspectives on upcoming regulatory changes.

signals.title: France's B2B e-invoicing reception mandate effective September 1, 2026
signals.body: All B2B companies in France must be able to receive electronic invoices starting September 1, 2026, regardless of their size. This requires using an approved platform (PA) and accepting structured formats like Factur-X, UBL, or CII.
signals.implication: Urgency for Sage and its partners to ensure full readiness for the e-invoicing reception mandate, as non-compliance carries significant risk.

signals.title: Sage E-invoicing France experienced degraded performance
signals.body: Sage E-invoicing France experienced degraded performance affecting 7 components, including Sage Active and Sage 100 Partner Cloud (FR), on August 11, 2026. The issue impacted data synchronization and processing, with some updates remaining in an "Awaiting" status.
signals.implication: Potential disruption to Sage's e-invoicing services in France, impacting compliance with the upcoming PA mandate and user trust.
